diagnosis.root_cause: The subscriber's CATV service is provisioned and the ONU is online, but the CATV interface is not synchronized (catv_synced=0). Internet service is unaffected, indicating a CATV/RF path or tuner synchronization problem rather than an EPON data fault.
evidence: The complaint is specifically that Internet works but TV channels never came on.
The subscriber has CATV capability and service enabled: has_catv=1, catv_service=1, and profile_CATV.
The ONU is online with normal optical readings: RX -20.4 dBm and TX 2.45 dBm.
Seven days of RX and TX telemetry are stable, distance is constant, and TX bias current is healthy; there is no evidence of fibre degradation, laser degradation, or distance change.
All tested peers on EPON0/7 are online and healthy, so there is no shared PON, splitter, port, or OLT outage.
The OLT and router are healthy and responding normally.
RADIUS exists, matches CRM, and the subscriber has normal session activity and traffic, ruling out authentication or Internet provisioning faults.
The expected customer VLAN 1037 is present and matches the actual VLAN, ruling out stuck provisioning on VLAN 46.
The decisive abnormality is catv_synced=0 while the data service remains operational, consistent with CATV drift or loss of CATV synchronization confined to this customer.

remediation.action: Check CATV optical/RF input level and signal quality at the ONU and customer outlet, inspect or reseat coaxial/fibre connectors and splitters, and rescan or reinitialize the ONU CATV tuner. Replace the ONU or repair the CATV drop/path if synchronization cannot be restored. Verify that catv_synced becomes 1 after remediation.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is recorded as subscribed to CATV but catv_synced is 0, so the CATV state was never pushed to the ONU. Data service is unaffected; only the television service is missing.
expected_reasoning: The customer reports working internet and missing television
catv_service is 1 and catv_synced is 0, so the subscription exists and the device state does not match it
The ONU model supports CATV, so this is not an equipment limitation
Optical readings are normal and the live probe confirms the ONU is healthy
Sessions and daily traffic are normal, consistent with working data service
The OLT and router are healthy and no shared fault exists
This is a service state mismatch on one dimension, of the same class as the 84 unsynced lines in the estate
It is resolved by re-pushing the CATV state rather than by any field work
distractors: Every network signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The complaint could be read as customer equipment rather than provisioning
